title: A C implementation of the Smith massager algorithm
summary: We describe a C implementation of the Las Vegas algorithm of Birmpilis, Labahn and Storjohann from 2020 for computing the Smith normal form of a nonsingular integer matrix. The algorithm computes a Smith massager for the input matrix using $O(n^ω\, \B(\log n + \log \|A\|)\, (\log n)^2)$ bit operations, which is softly equivalent to the cost of multiplying two matrices of the same dimension and entry size.
